messages:
maria-g: Quick sync — cutover window next Thu 09:00-12:00 PT. Posting owners and blockers so we can close prechecks. Who owns SDK toggle + fallback?
sam-l: I can own the SDK toggle (feature flag: `api.v2.enable`). Will add a canary for mobile + web.
jun-park: I’ll own the routing fallback rules (route policy + cost tier). Need to know if we should fall back to `model-v1` or a slim `v2-compat` variant.
ryan_o: prefer `v2-compat` to keep semantics. I’ll wire the rollback play and make the priority list: 1) v2-compat, 2) model-v1.
maria-g: ack. Sam — can you push the SDK patch to set the `enable` flag to `canary` by Tue EOD? Include env var `SDK_API_V2_CANARY=true` in CI job.
sam-l: Yep. I’ll open a tiny PR and tag @jun-park and @ryan_o for exposes. Will add smoke test that hits `/v2/generate` and asserts 200 + no regressions on token costs.
jun-park: For routing, I need the exact endpoint path and header names so I can add rules to the router. Is it still `POST /v2/generate` with `x-client-sdk` header?
maria-g: yes — same path. Header: `x-client-sdk-version`. If missing, treat as non-upgraded client and route to compatibility lane.
ryan_o: infra-bot FYI — can we reserve 4 dedicated GPU slots during the 3h window for canary traffic?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Reserved 4 N4 GPUs in us-west-2 for project: redwood-cutover (reservation id: res-2026-03-17-01). :white_check_mark:
maria-g: thanks infra-bot. Jun — please add a step in your rollout checklist: if latency p50 increases > 30% for 5m, auto-flip SDK canary back to off and notify #incidents.
jun-park: added. Also adding an automated smoke that compares `avg_token_ms` before/after.
sam-l: PR #4127 opened: `feat(sdk): canary flag for v2` — includes tests and CI job with `SDK_API_V2_CANARY=true`. Tagging @maria-g for release window.
maria-g: reviewed, minor nit on test timeout. Approving after fix.
ryan_o: one dependency: eng-runtime needs to land the `kv-cache` patch which reduces cold-start tails. ETA Wed morning. If that slips, we should shrink the canary.
maria-g: noted. If runtime patch slips, we reduce canary to 5% traffic and hold extended smoke for 30m.
sam-l: will add traffic ramp steps to the SDK rollout doc: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 15m waits.
jun-park: final ask — who owns customer communication / changelog entry? We should prep customers who have pinned model versions.
maria-g: Product will draft a short changelog and email for pinned customers. I’ll loop in @product.urgent.
ryan_o: final: If any blocker pops, please @me and I’ll run rollback + incident bridge.
maria-g: perfect. Action items recap: Sam — SDK PR + canary CI by Tue EOD; Jun — routing rules + rollback trigger; Ryan — rollback runbook + monitor boards; Infra — reserve GPUs (done). Closing once SDK PR merged and eng-runtime patch lands. Thanks!
